name: Rizzle's Schematics
summary: Rizzle's unguarded plans describe the refining of indurium ore. The scrawls point to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman, in the Badlands, as where the ore comes from, and many of the other notes are about heat resistance. A lump of raw ore sits on the plans as a paperweight, and you carry that sample to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats. This follows Keeping Pace.

sections.title: Notes on Indurium
sections.body: Rizzle's schematics describe the refining of indurium ore. Rizzle's scrawls point to the dwarves' dig at Uldaman, in the Badlands, as where the ore comes from. Many of the other notes are about how well it resists heat. A lump of raw indurium ore holds the plans down as a paperweight, and that sample is what you take to Pozzik.

sections.title: Pozzik's Verdict
sections.body: Pozzik finds indurium interesting. If it resists heat to the degree you say, that could account for how much the gnomes have improved of late. The sample will be invaluable for tests, though Pozzik will need more for it to be of any real use.
